latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Google Video Editor skill.
- Instantly edit and export MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM videos (up to 500MB) via descriptive prompts—no editing software needed.
- Automatic, cloud-based AI handles trimming, transitions, music, and exports polished videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Seamless onboarding: anonymous token/credits management, session handling, and supported formats all handled for you.
- Clear error feedback and guided workflows for uploads, timeline previews, exports, and credits.
- Ideal for casual creators and marketers seeking quick, professional-quality edits without the learning curve.
